value.rationale: Two distinguished sediment desorption thresholds supply a direct physical reason to examine whether an intermediate water-quality equilibrium joins the conventional two. The result determines a sharp minimum dimensionless threshold separation and the full nonempty feedback-gain window for three simultaneous stable states, including semistable folds and central stability reversal; it is an exact parameter classification, not an arbitrary isolated computation. It is explicitly a theoretical benchmark, not a calibrated hydrological prediction.
